reasons: The Datadog query is postgresql.rows_updated (rows updated per second), but the candidate uses postgresql.blks_hit, which counts buffer blocks hit in cache. That is a different quantity and unit.
The template variable $scope has no prefix and default '*', so dropping it is correct.

The candidate is translated, but it should not be: the rows-updated metric is not the one used. Either map it to the matching OTel metric (for example postgresql.rows filtered by operation=updated, if defined and present in the dataset) or block with MISSING_METRIC_MAPPING.
Using avg() over a rate of a monotonic sum with no by-clause is structurally consistent with the Datadog avg, but it applies to the wrong metric.
